## HIGH IMPACT

### Component: `ha-outlined-icon-button` → `ha-icon-button` Migration

**What changed:** PR #54571 "Migrate ha-outlined-icon-button to ha-icon-button" removes the `ha-outlined-icon-button` element entirely.

**What it affects:** The ha-lcars preamble does not directly target `ha-outlined-icon-button` by name, but if any card-mod rules in user dashboards or LCARS sub-themes reference `ha-outlined-icon-button`, those selectors are now dead. More critically, the visual appearance of icon buttons throughout the UI will change — `ha-outlined-icon-button` rendered with a visible outline/border, while `ha-icon-button` does not. Any card-mod CSS that relied on the outlined variant's border for LCARS styling will silently stop applying.

**LCARS rules affected:** `card-mod-root-yaml` → `div.header` block targets `ha-icon-button` and `ha-button-menu > ha-icon-button`. These selectors survive the migration and continue to work. However, any internal styling assumptions about `ha-outlined-icon-button` having a border that LCARS overrides are now moot.

**Suggested fix:** Audit all LCARS sub-theme card-mod rules for any remaining `ha-outlined-icon-button` selectors and replace them with `ha-icon-button`. Verify the LCARS header toolbar icon buttons still render correctly since the underlying element changed.

---

### Component: `ha-md-list` / `ha-md-list-item` Removal

**What changed:** PR #54569 "Migrate remaining ha-md-list usages and remove ha-md-list" and PR #54580 "Remove @material/web" remove `ha-md-list` and `ha-md-list-item` elements from the HA frontend entirely.

**What it affects:** The ha-lcars `card-mod-config-yaml` section contains explicit selectors targeting `ha-md-list` and `ha-md-list-item`:

```yaml
ha-md-list {
  --md-sys-color-surface: transparent !important;
  padding-top: 0px;

  ha-md-list-item {
    background-color: var(--lcars-card-mid-color);
    --md-list-item-label-text-color: var(--lcars-card-mid-text);
    --md-list-item-supporting-text-color: var(--lcars-card-mid-text);
    border-radius: 999px;
    margin-block: 5px;
  }
  ha-md-list-item:first-child { ... }
  ha-md-list-item:last-child { ... }
}
```

This block appears specifically in the `"ha-config-info $ hass-subpage div.content"` → `"ha-card"` → `":is(.pages)"` section. Since `ha-md-list` and `ha-md-list-item` no longer exist, the entire styled list in the System Info config page will lose all LCARS styling (rounded pill rows, top/mid/bottom color differentiation).

The replacement elements are `ha-list-nav` + `ha-list-item-button` (already used elsewhere in LCARS for the same pattern in `ha-config-navigation-list`).

**Suggested fix:** Replace the `ha-md-list` / `ha-md-list-item` selectors in the `.pages` block inside `card-mod-config-yaml` with `ha-list-nav` / `ha-list-item-button` to match the pattern already used in the `ha-config-navigation-list` and `ha-config-system-navigation` sections:

```css
ha-list-nav {
  padding-top: 0px;

  ha-list-item-button {
    background-color: var(--lcars-card-mid-color);
    --primary-text-color: var(--lcars-card-mid-text);
    --secondary-text-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary-text-color) 80%, transparent);
    border-radius: 999px;
    margin-block: 5px;
  }
  ha-list-item-button:first-child { ... }
  ha-list-item-button:last-child { ... }
}
```

---

### Component: `--mdc-typography-*` Custom Properties Removed

**What changed:** PR #54201 "Remove dead --mdc-typography-* custom properties" removes these MDC typography tokens from HA's own CSS.

**What it affects:** The ha-lcars `preamble.yaml` `&base` block defines:

```yaml
mdc-typography-button-font-family: var(--font-family)
mdc-typography-body2-font-family: var(--font-family)
mdc-typography-font-family: var(--font-family)
```

These are CSS custom properties set at theme level (i.e., `--mdc-typography-button-font-family`, `--mdc-typography-body2-font-family`, `--mdc-typography-font-family`). Since HA no longer reads these variables anywhere, setting them has zero effect. The LCARS font (Tungsten/Antonio) will no longer be applied to any UI elements that previously consumed these MDC tokens.

**Suggested fix:** Remove the three `mdc-typography-*-font-family` entries from `&base` in `preamble.yaml` (they're dead weight). Then identify which elements previously relied on these tokens and add explicit `font-family: var(--font-family)` rules via card-mod to the relevant shadow DOM scopes. The `ha-font-family-body` variable (already set in `&base`) is the correct HA-native replacement.

---

### Component: `ha-formfield` Removal

**What changed:** PR #54200 "Drop ha-formfield in favour of the switch's own label" removes the `ha-formfield` element.

**What it affects:** While ha-lcars does not appear to directly target `ha-formfield` in its card-mod selectors, `ha-formfield` was the wrapper element for toggle switches throughout dialogs, config panels, and more-info drawers. Its removal means the shadow DOM structure of any switch/toggle row has changed. LCARS card-mod rules that target the surrounding structure of form controls (particularly in `card-mod-dialog-yaml` and `card-mod-config-yaml`) may now fail to reach their targets if they relied on `ha-formfield` being an intermediate element in the shadow DOM path.

**Suggested fix:** Inspect toggle/switch controls in dialogs and config pages while LCARS is active. If switch labels or alignment appear broken, add targeted card-mod rules that address the new switch label structure (now rendered directly inside the switch component's shadow DOM) rather than relying on `ha-formfield` as an ancestor.

---

### Component: Panel Background Stacking Context Change

**What changed:** PR #55485 "Move the panel background stacking context off partial-panel-resolver" changes where the background stacking context is established for panels.

**What it affects:** The ha-lcars `card-mod-root-yaml` `.:` block sets rules on `hui-panel-view` and `@container view-container`:

```css
hui-panel-view {
  overflow: hidden;
}
@container view-container (min-width: 0px) {
  hui-panel-view {
    margin: 5px 0px 0px 5px !important;
    max-height: calc(100vh - 45px);
  }
}
```

Moving the stacking context off `partial-panel-resolver` can affect z-index layering and overflow clipping behavior for LCARS panels. The `z-index: 9990` and `z-index: 9991` values used in `card-mod-drawer` for the texture/backlight overlays may now stack incorrectly relative to panel content, potentially causing the backlight gradient or noise texture to appear behind panel elements when they should be above (or vice versa).

**Suggested fix:** Test the texture overlay (`card-mod-drawer` `::before` and `::after` pseudo-elements with `z-index: 9990/9991`) against panels in the updated frontend. If layering is broken, adjust z-index values. Also test that `hui-panel-view overflow: hidden` still clips correctly.

## MEDIUM IMPACT

### Component: Avatar / Entity Picture Shape Change

**What changed:** PR #54902 "Use rounded squares for avatars and entity pictures" changes entity pictures from circles to rounded squares throughout the UI.

**What it affects:** LCARS does not explicitly override the avatar/entity picture border-radius via a named variable. However, this is a global visual change that affects entity rows, target pickers, and automation elements. The LCARS `hui-generic-entity-row` card-mod block sets `state-badge` background and border-radius:

```css
state-badge {
  border-top-right-radius: 0px;
  border-bottom-right-radius: 0px;
  border-top-left-radius: 0px;
  border-bottom-left-radius: 0px;
}
```

This override is already `0px` so the shape-change in HA won't break LCARS's own pill-style entity rows. But entity pictures appearing in other contexts (target picker, add-element dialog, automation target tree) will now appear as rounded squares instead of circles, which may look inconsistent with the LCARS aesthetic.

**Suggested fix:** No immediate fix required for existing card-mod rules. Optionally, add card-mod rules to force entity pictures in the target picker to use LCARS-preferred shapes if rounded squares are visually unwanted.

---

### Component: `ha-checkbox` — Touch Area and Variant Changes

**What changed:** PR #54617 "Increase touch area of ha-checkbox" and PR #55071 "Add variant to ha-checkbox" change the checkbox element's sizing and introduce a `variant` attribute that changes rendering.

**What it affects:** The ha-lcars todo-list card-mod block targets `ha-checkbox` inside `ha-check-list-item`:

```css
ha-checkbox {
  border-right: var(--check-border-right) solid var(--lcars-background-color);
  border-left: var(--check-border-left) solid var(--lcars-background-color);
  height: 100%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  --mdc-checkbox-checked-color: var(--completed-color);
  ...
}
```

The increased touch area may change the effective rendered size of the checkbox, pushing surrounding content in LCARS todo rows. The `--mdc-checkbox-checked-color` variable may also no longer apply if the checkbox migrated away from MDC internals (given the broader `@material/web` removal in #54580).

**Suggested fix:** Test todo-list cards with the new checkbox sizing. The `--mdc-checkbox-checked-color` property should be replaced with the appropriate HA-native or WebAwesome checkbox color variable (check the new `ha-checkbox` implementation for the correct custom property name). The border rules should still apply since they target the `ha-checkbox` element's own box model.

---

### Component: `ha-ripple` — Custom Implementation

**What changed:** PR #54508 "Replace ha-ripple Material base with own implementation" replaces the Material-based ripple with a custom HA implementation.

**What it affects:** The ha-lcars `&base` block and card button styles set:

```yaml
lcars-ripple-color: var(--lcars-ui-mix-color)
lcars-ripple-pressed-opacity: 0.4
lcars-ripple-hover-opacity: 0.12
```

And in card-mod-card-yaml:
```css
--ha-ripple-color: var(--lcars-ripple-color);
--ha-ripple-pressed-opacity: var(--lcars-ripple-pressed-opacity);
--ha-ripple-hover-opacity: var(--lcars-ripple-hover-opacity);
```

The custom variables `--ha-ripple-color`, `--ha-ripple-pressed-opacity`, and `--ha-ripple-hover-opacity` are LCARS-defined (not HA-defined). If HA's new ripple implementation uses different variable names or reads different tokens, LCARS's ripple customization will silently stop working. The button press feedback described in `defaults.yaml` (issue #149 fix) would revert to default HA ripple behavior.

**Suggested fix:** Verify that HA's new `ha-ripple` implementation still reads `--ha-ripple-color`, `--ha-ripple-pressed-opacity`, and `--ha-ripple-hover-opacity`. If the variable names changed in the new implementation, update them in `card-mod-card-yaml` and `defaults.yaml`.

### Component: Integration Cards Layout Redesign

**What changed:** PR #55147 "Redesign integration cards with a compact layout" changes the visual structure of integration cards on the integrations dashboard.

**What it affects:** The ha-lcars `card-mod-config-yaml` block extensively styles `ha-config-integrations` subpages via `"ha-config-integrations $ hass-tabs-subpage $"`. While this only targets `div.bottom-bar`, the overall visual redesign of integration cards (new compact layout) means the LCARS theme will not apply any specific styling to the card content itself — integration cards will display in HA's new default compact layout without LCARS customization.

**Suggested fix:** If integration card appearance is important to LCARS aesthetics, add targeted card-mod selectors for the new integration card structure. Otherwise, no fix strictly required since the LCARS config mod only targets the bottom bar.

### Component: `ha-tab-group` / `ha-tab-group-tab` — Tabs Accessibility Refactor

**What changed:** PR #55165 "Tabs subpage improve tabs a11y" changes tab accessibility structure. Also PR #54991 "Fix tabs toolbar-icon slot width" changes slot behavior.

**What it affects:** The ha-lcars `card-mod-root-yaml` has extensive rules for `ha-tab-group$` and `ha-tab-group-tab$`:

```css
ha-tab-group$ {
  :host {
    margin-left: 30px;
    border-left: solid var(--lcars-background-color) 4px;
    ...
  }
  .tab-group-top { --safe-track-width: 0px; }
  .tabs { overflow-y: hidden; }
}
ha-tab-group-tab$ {
  :host { ... }
  :host([aria-selected="true"]),
  :host([active]) { background-color: var(--lcars-ui-tertiary); }
  div.tab { ... }
}
```

The a11y refactor may change the shadow DOM class names (`.tab-group-top`, `.tabs`, `div.tab`) or ARIA attribute names used for selection state. If `.tab-group-top` is renamed or removed, the `--safe-track-width: 0px` rule silently becomes dead. If `div.tab` structure changes, the `border-right` and `text-align` rules on `div.tab` break.

**Suggested fix:** Test dashboard tab rendering with LCARS active. Verify that `div.tab` still exists inside `ha-tab-group-tab`'s shadow DOM, that `.tab-group-top` and `.tabs` class names are unchanged, and that `[aria-selected="true"]` still fires for active tabs (vs. alternative selectors like `[selected]`).

The new section types (entities strategy, device strategy) render different internal structure. **Suggested fix:** Test new section types (entities strategy, device strategy) with LCARS active. Check that card padding and the overall LCARS frame classes (header/middle/footer) still apply correctly inside the new section containers.
